prereg: COMMITTED BEFORE THE RUN — no result is attached. The reading rules below are frozen; the run reports whichever verdict the numbers land on.
question: Does the surviving one-sided band on the 52-member three-night union (smear_remarch.json: x05-x25 roundness 0.878-0.885 vs mirror 0.950-0.968; odd FWHM +0.180 px at the x05/x95 pair reversing to -0.100 at x35/x65; major-only growth +0.206 px over the outer pairs) follow the covering MEMBERS' OWN sampling composition — the single-frame optics term reaching the coadd — or stand as a member-composition-independent (canvas-tied) addition?
subject: web/results/aug09/stack_july31+aug06+aug09_full_wcs.fit — the re-march's own product; observations are smear_remarch.json's 23 recorded positions and their per-star lists (lists/*.lst), NOT a new march. No pixel is read anywhere in this arm.
members: The 52 groups sub-stacks under sessions/{july31,aug06,aug09}/work/groups_set-0N/sub_*.fit excluding _l1arm/_l1ctrl/_rev2 dirs — enumeration VERIFIED against the union's compose gate record before this prereg was frozen: CALSET multiset matches set-for-set, 52/52 (compose_gate_stack_july31+aug06+aug09_full.json). Each carries its own solved RA---TAN-SIP A_ORDER=3 WCS (probed on one member per night).

member_own_coordinates.projection: astropy wcs_world2pix (linear TAN part) of each star's own tool-reported RA/Dec into each member; a member covers the star if the projection lands inside [0,W)x[0,H) of that member's own canvas. The linear approximation's SIP residual is MEASURED on a sample (all_world2pix vs wcs_world2pix, >=100 stars x 3 members, one per night) and reported as a tolerance; if the median exceeds 20 px (1% of the normalization) the run switches to all_world2pix and says so.
member_own_coordinates.signed_x: (x - W/2)/(W/2) in the member's own canvas, range -1..+1 — the one-sided axis
member_own_coordinates.rho: sqrt((x-W/2)^2 + (y-H/2)^2)/(H/2) — half-short-side normalization, the repo's convention (DISTNORM = half short side; member corner sits near 1.78)
member_own_coordinates.orientation_control: all 52 members' WCS rotation angles (from the CD matrix) must agree within 2 degrees, else signed-x pooling is invalid and the run STOPS with the spread reported

per_star_selection: Per position, the TOP 30 stars by amplitude A from the recorded list — exactly the re-march instrument's own selection ('the 30 brightest fits'), so depth stays rank-matched to the recorded medians. Secondary (stated, power only): top 100 by A, same rank-matching logic, reported separately and never mixed. major = max(FWHMx,FWHMy), minor = min, roundness = min/max (the instrument's definition). Stars deduplicated by exact (RA,Dec) across overlapping crops for pooled fits; kept per-box for pair tables.

tests.T1_lever: Across the 9 mirrored pairs (x05/x95 .. x45/x55), the pair deltas of composition: mean member-own rho, mean member-own signed_x, and n_cover. If all three are ~0 while the shape deltas stand, member sampling CANNOT explain the band.
tests.T2_tracking: Do composition deltas track the shape deltas across pairs — including the sign reversal at x35/x65? Reported as the pair-level profile side by side plus a least-squares fit of pair shape-delta on pair composition-deltas.
tests.T3_major_channel: Single-raw measurement (mechanism_and_specs.json fits): member-own MAJOR is RADIAL — adding a signed-x term to the radial fit buys F=0.017 — while ROUNDNESS carries the one-sided x term at 13.8 SE. Therefore any major-axis one-sidedness explained by members must arrive through the RHO composition, not signed-x. If pair rho-deltas are ~0 and major deltas stand, optics transfer cannot explain the major band regardless of T2.
tests.T4_residual: Star-level fit (top-30 primary): major_i and roundness_i on [1, mean_rho_i, mean_signed_x_i, n_cover_i, LEFT_i] where LEFT = membership in the x05-x45 half. Inference is CLUSTER-LEVEL: residuals from the composition-only model are averaged per box, and the 9 pair differences of those box means give the composition-unexplained one-sided residual with its SE over pairs. A box-label permutation null (500 draws at pair level) is computed beside it.

reading_rules.OPTICS_TRANSFER_CONSISTENT: composition deltas non-zero, tracking the shape-delta profile in sign including the reversal, AND the T4 composition-unexplained residual < 2 SE of zero — the band is the members' own term reaching the coadd; compose-homography-smear's surviving band re-scopes to one-sided-band.
reading_rules.COMPOSE_ADDED: T4 residual >= 3 SE — a member-composition-independent one-sided term stands, quoted with its SE as 'canvas-tied, composition-unexplained'; this arm does NOT identify its mechanism (registration vs resample phase vs other) and must not be quoted as doing so.
reading_rules.AMBIGUOUS: between 2 and 3 SE, or T1 shows a lever too small to test T2 while T4 is under-powered — reported as such with the numbers, no verdict.
reading_rules.STOP_CONDITIONS: orientation control fails; or any recorded position projects in-frame to ZERO members (geometry bug — the union cannot have measured sky no member covers); or the enumeration re-check against the gate record fails at run time.

cannot_conclude: This arm attributes the band to member-sampling or not. It cannot identify a compose-side mechanism, cannot calibrate member amplitudes (no cross-instrument amplitude import — products understate raws, measured), and does not touch the optics term's own attribution (one-sided-band's open half).

amendment_1_orientation_control.blind_status: The original control FIRED (rotation spread 32.491 deg > 2) and the run STOPPED inside member_geometry — before any star list or band quantity was read. No analysis output existed when this amendment was written.
amendment_1_orientation_control.what_was_wrong: The control asserted ONE shared orientation across all 52 members. Measured header-only: rotation clusters BY SET (within-set spread ~1-2 deg; e.g. aug09/set-02 +14.3..+17.3, july31/set-01 -13.6..-15.2, aug06/set-01 -5.9..-6.9) and a linear rotation~RA fit leaves 8.7 deg RMS — so the spread is the per-aim ROLL of a re-aimed ballhead camera, one roll per set, not a solve defect and not smooth pointing geometry. The premise 'pooling needs shared orientation' was mistaken: member-own (signed_x, rho) are computed through each member's OWN WCS, exact per member at any roll.
amendment_1_orientation_control.amended_control: WITHIN-SET rotation spread must be < 2 deg (a member disagreeing with its own set's roll is a solve/geometry bug -> STOP); the between-set spread is reported as measured geometry, not a stop.
amendment_1_orientation_control.consequence_for_reading: Between-set roll spread partially DECOHERES the members' sensor-fixed one-sided axes on the union canvas (extreme-pair projection factor cos 32.5 deg = 0.84), so a small T1 composition lever is partly expected geometry; this is stated with the T1 result rather than read as 'members cannot matter'.

instrument: rho_march.py beside this record — headers and recorded tool measurements only; reads no pixel; reports only; exits 0.
